query:
SELECT
                u.email,
                u.macro_user_id AS "fusion_user_id?",
                u."organizationId" AS "organization_id?"
            FROM "UserApiKey" k
            JOIN "User" u
                ON u.id = k.user_id
                OR u.email = split_part(k.user_id, '|', 2)
            WHERE k.hash = $1
